g.title: cluster_graph
g.text: chr1 in blue; s5, an HG002 allele in place of s3, in orange

g.title: cluster_query
g.text: each node is a row filed under a chr1 interval; the browser fetches the rows that overlap the window

g.title: cluster_drawn
g.text: yellow marks the window, chr1:25-30, and the blue line traces chr1's path
s2 and s4, pale, are the chr1 nodes at the far ends of the bubble's links

g.title: hits
g.text: s5 lies off chr1, so the tool files it under the whole span its bubble hangs from, chr1:10-40.
The tool files each link to cover both its nodes, so viewing anywhere in chr1:10-40 fetches s5 and its links.
viewing chr1:25-30 fetches the bubble out to chr1:10-40
